component.name: Habit Trackers by Madhab
component.summary: Private, offline habit and personal productivity tracking

description.p: Habit Trackers by Madhab is a native Linux desktop application for recording habits and organizing personal goals. It is designed around local-first storage so personal habit records stay on the user's device.
The engineering preview uses GTK 4, Rust and SQLite. Core tracking is intended to work offline without an account, cloud synchronization, advertising, telemetry or remote AI.
Engineering preview. This is not a stable release.
